fact: The PITN2R rural digital transformation project, financed by IDA and AFD at about 28 billion CFA francs over five years, targets 2,128 villages in 33 communes, and a mission toured Collines, Borgou, Alibori, Donga and Atacora ahead of imminent deployment of rural connectivity.
title: Usage des Tic en milieu paysan au Bénin: L'espoir de couverture des zones blanches
